name: The Observatory
intro: A building full of instruments, all of them pointed not at the sky but at the town below.
outro: The last flight of stairs goes up into the light you have been watching all week.

nodes.label: Unlocked
nodes.text: The door is unlocked. Of course it is. You know where the key is anyway.

nodes.label: Steady Yourself
nodes.text: Whatever is in here, you would rather meet it breathing slowly.

nodes.label: Read The Notes
nodes.text: Years of observations, in handwriting you recognise. It is yours. It is not yours yet.

nodes.label: Call Someone
nodes.text: Before you go up. Just in case going up is a one-way thing.

nodes.label: Sit With It
nodes.text: Nobody to call. That is also an answer, and it is not a sad one.

nodes.label: The Last Stairs
nodes.text: Up. The light gets warmer with every step, which is somehow worse.
